text:
ingrid: FYI starting tenant_metadata enum->text swap (mg_4727) at 22:00 UTC. Quiet window 20:00-23:00. Expect short locks on tenants with >1M rows. tagging @matt @carol for rollforward/rollback.

deploybot: scheduled migration mg_4727 by ingrid at 3382012345. Estimated affected rows: 2.1M. Plan: online-apply w/ chunking; watch lock_watch metric. Commands: /deploybot abort mg_4727, /deploybot pin-version v1.4.2

matt: on call will watch lock_watch and p99 latency. set alert if lock_watch > 5 for >30s :eyes:

carol: re: rollback, we have snapshot at 21:50 UTC and manual unpin plan in release notes: https://redwood/internal/release-notes/rel_1.4.2

sasha: quick staging check ran fine. sample SQL used:
```
ALTER TYPE tenant_metadata ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'legacy_tag' BEFORE 'current';
-- backfill:
UPDATE tenants SET metadata = jsonb_set(metadata, '{flags}', '"legacy_tag"', true) WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 10000;
```

ingrid: if we see lock spikes, holdpoint is to pause chunking and fall back to async backfill. manual steps:
- run `/deploybot abort mg_4727` to stop
- deploy tiny patch mg_4727-hotfix and rerun

deploybot: note: canary routing active for 10% of traffic to v1.4.2-resilient variant during migration window.

oncall: I'll be on standby 21:30-23:30. ping me with @oncall if we need immediate rollback.

matt: ok. I'll create the short checklist in the runbook and pin the DB migration row in the deploy tracker.

carol: +1. posting post-mortem template link in the channel post-deploy.

ingrid: thanks team. starting preflight at 21:40.
